description: CRIT-005 is not met: the score renderer accepts semantically contradictory measured values, duplicate source references, and organs missing their required component fields, then renders the supplied percentage as a real score instead of failing the score section closed.

evidence.snippet: validScoreOrgan checks only broad status/value/period/reason/reference shapes; it does not enforce exact component schemas, unique sorted references, or agreement between value and numerator/denominator. A fresh runtime probe with value=100, numerator=0, denominator=1, duplicate refs, and only components.timezone was accepted for all four cards.

resolution.notes: The renderer now checks exact organ/period/component schemas, per-organ component ratios, computed percentages, sorted unique UUID references, and period ordering. Executable negative probes cover contradictory ratios, duplicate refs, and incomplete components.
